objective: Calibrate an inference-only Ctrl-World guidance scale under the frozen ACWM screen protocol.

falsification_criterion: No candidate strictly improves the primary metric while preserving every protected metric; all candidates remain abstained.
selection_reason: This is a source-preserving, one-parameter calibration that tests the complete eight-slot ACWM loop before admitting any training or model mutation.
